name: Cross to Bear
source:
One day, Morishita Rimu is summoned by a group of bad boys after school, blackmailed to obey them, or her childhood friend Oda Takuro will get a hard time......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE025208.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
有一天，森下里梦放学后被一群坏男孩召唤，勒索她必须服从他们，否则她的青梅竹马织田拓郎就会过得很艰难……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE025208.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
